correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the equivariant retraction and the nonabelian attaching words. The geometric diagonal is full in the center-coned triangulation; normalizing the complementary barycentric weights defines an equivariant strong deformation retract off the diagonal. A square coming from distinct incident edges loses exactly its common-end diagonal corner. Label the three retained corners q,r,s in consecutive order and its center c. The only center triangles are cqr and crs; collapse the free spokes cq and cs with their triangles, then remove c along cr. Center supports are disjoint and the C₃×S₂ action has trivial stabilizer on these ordered centers, so the same collapses descend. Equal-edge squares have their central vertex and two diagonal corners removed; disjoint-edge squares remain intact. Thus the quotient reduces to the stated deleted-product CW model. The cell representatives and count follow by indexing each two-cell by its increasing pair of right vertices, translating the first left vertex to a₀, and choosing one of two distinct other left vertices. The ordered square traversals are L_i⁺ R_{i,j} R_{j,i}⁻¹ (L_j⁻)⁻¹ and L_i⁻ R_{i,j} R_{j,i}⁻¹ (L_j⁺)⁻¹, not merely their signed edge multisets. The specified tree leaves A:y⁻¹x_j⁻¹ and B:x_i y⁻¹. Solve B for y and transfer the other attaching map by homotopy before cancellation; this is a presentation-complex move, not a free-face collapse of the original square pair. The resulting x_i x_j relations give x_j=x₁⁻¹ for j>1 and leave a circle with binomial(n−1,2) attaching maps of degree −2. At n≥3 one such cell makes RP²; the others now attach by nullhomotopic maps, giving the sphere wedge of the claimed rank. This also checks the n=3 boundary and integral consequences without inferring homotopy type from homology.
residual_risks: The frozen verifier compares sorted signed edge lists at lines 124 and 146; despite the wording of its verification description, those assertions do not test traversal order. That order was checked separately by tracing the four oriented sides; the topology proof does not depend on the checker.
The recorded finite runs at n=3–9 do not establish the uniform or equivariant statements alone. The quotient is ordinary and nonfree, not the Borel construction.

value.rationale: This is a uniform integral homotopy classification for a natural nonfree symmetry of a standard configuration family. The quotient fundamental group remains of order two while the number of actual wedge-sphere summands grows quadratically. The integral attaching-map calculation detects more than rational symmetry invariants or the n=3 special case, and distinguishes this proper subgroup from the full-symmetry disk quotient.
residual_risks: No other shore subgroup, more particles, equivariant homotopy type, or inclusion-map classification is claimed.
